description: Source code for agent tools related to file system operations, MIME detection, and sandboxed file handling in a project involving OpenClaw. Includes utility functions, class definitions, and tool creation functions for reading, writing, and editing files with sandbox and workspace boundaries.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamp a number between min and max values.

methods.name: resolveAdaptiveReadMaxBytes
methods.description: Calculate adaptive maximum bytes for reading based on model context window tokens.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Format byte size into human-readable string.

methods.name: getToolResultText
methods.description: Extract concatenated text from AgentToolResult content blocks.

methods.name: withToolResultText
methods.description: Replace or add text content block in AgentToolResult.

methods.name: extractReadTruncationDetails
methods.description: Extract truncation info from AgentToolResult details.

methods.name: stripReadContinuationNotice
methods.description: Remove continuation notice from text.

methods.name: stripReadTruncationContentDetails
methods.description: Remove content details from truncation info in result.

methods.name: executeReadWithAdaptivePaging
methods.description: Perform paged read with adaptive byte limit, concatenating results.

methods.name: rewriteReadImageHeader
methods.description: Update image read header with correct MIME type.

methods.name: normalizeReadImageResult
methods.description: Normalize image MIME type in result, updating headers and content blocks.

methods.name: wrapToolWorkspaceRootGuard
methods.description: Wrap a tool to enforce workspace root path guard.

methods.name: mapContainerPathToWorkspaceRoot
methods.description: Map container file path to workspace root considering container working directory.

methods.name: resolveToolPathAgainstWorkspaceRoot
methods.description: Resolve file path against workspace root, considering container workdir.

methods.name: readOptionalUtf8File
methods.description: Read file content as UTF-8 string, optionally from sandbox.

methods.name: appendMemoryFlushContent
methods.description: Append content to file, handling sandbox or host file system.

methods.name: wrapToolMemoryFlushAppendOnlyWrite
methods.description: Wrap a tool to restrict write operations to appending to a specific file.

methods.name: wrapToolWorkspaceRootGuardWithOptions
methods.description: Wrap a tool to enforce workspace root and optional container workdir guard.

methods.name: createSandboxedReadTool
methods.description: Create a sandboxed read tool with specified operations.

methods.name: createSandboxedWriteTool
methods.description: Create a sandboxed write tool with specified operations.

methods.name: createSandboxedEditTool
methods.description: Create a sandboxed edit tool with recovery and specified operations.

methods.name: createHostWorkspaceWriteTool
methods.description: Create a host workspace write tool, optionally workspace-only.

methods.name: createHostWorkspaceEditTool
methods.description: Create a host workspace edit tool, optionally workspace-only.

methods.name: createOpenClawReadTool
methods.description: Create an OpenClaw compatible read tool with adaptive paging and image sanitization.
